messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Discussion on define-raw-data
parts:
Hi,

this was reported on this list a couple of days ago together with a
few other problems. I am busy right now preparing for the Affy
workshop at RECOMB next week, so I haven't had to time to locate the
bug(s). They where introduced in one of the latest versions, but I'm
not sure in exactly which. I think v0.4.3 was a fairly well working
release. Until I have to time fix the problems, which I hope to look
into after April 21st, please roll back to v0.4.3. On Windows just
do:

Start a fresh R session:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbGet("aroma.affymetrix", "0.4.3", "zip")
install.packages("aroma.affymetrix_0.4.3.zip", repos=NULL)

Sorry for the mess.

Henrik
